opening.argument: The video repeatedly ties joining BitClub Network to financial freedom and extraordinary earnings, while describing a growing team and new people entering the business. The description states, “whoever joins Bitclub Network will be financially free, it's a fact!” A speaker also calls the opportunity “so legit” and “paying,” and presents potential income of about £700,000 a month. These are not isolated accounts of personal results: the speakers connect wealth and retirement claims to team members and continued recruitment. Together, the emphatic financial promises and the team-based structure show an opportunity promoted through recruitment and commissions, supporting the position that it is a recruitment-commission scam.
